description:
How each suburb voted at the 2019, 2022 and 2025 federal elections (House of Representatives): first-preference share by party, two-party-preferred Labor v Coalition, swings, informal vote and the electorate. Also state and national totals with turnout.

Coverage: About 7,500 suburbs per election (every suburb with at least 100 allocated formal votes), all 8 states and territories, and Australia; federal elections 2019, 2022 and 2025. Current to 2025-05-03. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/election-results-federal`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: formal_votes, informal_votes, informal_pct, labor_votes, coalition_votes, greens_votes, one_nation_votes, independent_votes, other_votes, labor_pct, coalition_pct, greens_pct, one_nation_pct, independent_pct, other_pct, tpp_labor_votes, tpp_coalition_votes, tpp_labor_pct, tpp_coalition_pct, labor_swing, coalition_swing, greens_swing, one_nation_swing, independent_swing, tpp_labor_swing, main_division, main_division_share_pct, divisions, enrolment, turnout_pct. Omit for all.

state.description: State or territory abbreviation: nsw, vic, qld, sa, wa, tas, act or nt.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
